exceptions.scope: Docusaurus build and local development dependency graph only
exceptions.reason: No patched release exists. Builds consume repository-controlled glob patterns and run without deployment credentials in PR validation. The published site consists of static files; never expose the development server publicly.
exceptions.resolution: Update the lock as soon as a compatible patched release is published; rerun npm ci, audit and the bilingual build. Re-review is required after expiry.
